issues.title: Gateway trusts the caller
issues.summary: The gateway forwards requests without checking who sends them.
issues.impact: Anything that can reach it is exposed.

issues.title: Invoices can lose their customer
issues.summary: Deleting a customer leaves an orphan invoice row behind.
issues.fix: Declare the link and cascade the delete.

issues.title: Mail sending gives up silently
issues.summary: A failed send is dropped and never attempted again; the Retry policy is missing.
issues.fix: Queue the send and attempt it again later.

issues.title: Search mixes concerns
issues.summary: The search module issues an n+1 query per hit and formats output.

issues.title: The readme is stale
issues.summary: The readme describes routes that no longer exist.

issues.title: Unrelated finding
issues.summary: Nightly batch holds a lock for an hour.
